title: The Weeping Icon
text: An icon of one of the Six weeps real tears into a silver bowl, slow and steady, a drop every few heartbeats. The painted eyes are red and raw. Pilgrims drink from it and go away smiling, and quiet.

options.label: Drink from the silver bowl, as the pilgrims do.

outcomes.text: It tastes of salt, and of peace.
It tastes of salt, and of a grief that is not yours. The grief does not leave.

options.label: The devout one prays before the icon, asking why it weeps.

outcomes.text: The icon's red eyes follow them out, and luck follows with them.

options.label: The Leader bottles the tears to sell; a god's grief is worth a fortune.

outcomes.text: They are worth their weight in gold. The pilgrims see you do it.
